'''November 2000 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Shaner's Outer Rim, Phoenix, Arizona on 10 November 2000. [[Brian Choongphol]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1445">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-11-outer-rim-opens-in-phoenix-11-10-00d1445/ outer-rim-opens-in-phoenix-11-10-00], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 11 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-11-outer-rim-opens-in-phoenix-11-10-00d1445/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Shaner's Outer Rim, Phoenix, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Choongphol]]
